newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat futures end mixed on poor exports.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat futures end mixed on poor exports.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures closed mixed on Thursday with nearbys down on lackluster USDA weekly export figures but deferreds up on spreads, traders said.
USDA on Thursday reported net sales for the week ended Oct 3 totaled 296,200 tonnes, down 50 percent from the previous week and 40 percent below the four-week average.

Volume was said to be light ahead of Friday's USDA crop production report. LFG Futures bought one million Dec on the day and General Mills bought 700,000 Dec, traders said. Louis Dreyfus and Cargill were also noted players.
Wheat closed one cent per bushel higher to two cents lower with December down one at $4.38 a bushel.
